escena: SCENE (deciding the last cut of a bakery campaign, Efeonce studio in Santiago, late afternoon): the camera sits in the air BETWEEN the two of them at eye height, close enough that each fills one side of the frame in three-quarter view, turned towards each other and NEITHER looking at the lens. Julio is on the left, mid-sentence with one hand open low over the table; Nexa is on the right, already answering, her chin lifted. Both wear the deep navy Efeonce pique polo, collar open, sleeves at the bicep, the small embroidered emblem on the left chest catching the light. Between and below them an editing monitor lies flat and awake, its azure-blue timeline the cool light that separates their two faces from the warm room. A hard low sun beam comes through the window behind Julio and rims his shoulder. 50mm at f/2, focus split between the two faces. Captions and file names exist on the monitor but sit at a grazing angle far below the focal plane, unreadable. Everything else is completely unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the matte-black top of the studio camera on its tripod we shoot past

escena: SCENE (Run and Gun shoot at a coffee roastery, Lima, mid morning): sharp in the near third of the frame is NEXA, the one MAKING IT POSSIBLE: she is at the monitor cart in three-quarter view, one hand steadying the rig and her eyes on the waveform, not on the talent. She wears the navy Efeonce trucker cap and the deep navy Efeonce pique polo: the cap sits snug and LOW-PROFILE, adult size, the distance from her brow to the top of the crown about a third of her head height, the band resting on her brows with no gap at the sides, the peak short and curved and no wider than her forehead. Well behind her and clearly OUT OF FOCUS, the roaster talks to camera under a hard shaft of window light with roasting dust drifting in it. The monitor she watches throws azure blue across her face and the cap's peak. On the floor at her feet, a short strip of ORANGE gaffer tape marks the cart's position, pressed down and already scuffed by the crew. 50mm at f/1.8, focus locked on Nexa. Printed call sheets are clipped to the cart but are creased and far outside the focal plane, unreadable. Everything is completely unbranded except the Efeonce garments.

lecho.objeto: the pale sunlit concrete floor of the roastery rising into the bottom of the frame right at the lens
lecho.tono: VERY LIGHT almost white sunlit concrete

escena: SCENE (the client is talking, first review meeting of a coffee chain's growth plan, Bogota, golden hour): Julio is the one RECEIVING. He is seated in three-quarter view, mouth CLOSED, eyes fixed off-frame to the right on whoever is speaking, one hand still on the table beside a pen he is not using. Caught at the instant he takes in what was just said: his brows have started to lift and his head is barely turning towards the speaker, the listening is mid-movement, not a held pose. He wears the navy Efeonce softshell jacket, zip halfway, over a plain dark tee, with the Efeonce lanyard at his neck, its badge hanging FACE-INWARD against his chest so only the blank back of the card is visible: this is a meeting, and the jacket is the register that says so. His own laptop is closed in front of him. Across the table, out of focus and cropped by the frame edge, a forearm gestures over a printed plan. Behind him a wall screen is awake with an azure-blue chart, throwing cool light along his jaw, while the low sun coming through the blinds lays warm bars across the table. 85mm at f/2, focus on his eyes. Text exists on the printed plan but sits at a steep angle well outside the focal plane, unreadable. Everything is completely unbranded except the Efeonce garments.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the dark walnut meeting table on the camera side
